changes.JS-ST-F1 MAJOR: replacement responses use an unhooked model-clock snapshot: posix_spawn helper text, proc_pidinfo task ticks and the driver st_date_future floor. posix_spawn finishes every fallible construction and record before committing the process side effect and returning the pid.
changes.JS-ST-F2 MAJOR: persistent per-process CPU accumulator over unhooked MODEL monotonic time with declared rate history. A retroactive declaration is allowed only before any counter is observed; transitions settle first. Civil shifts never alter ticks and counters never decrease.
changes.ST-C2-F1 MAJOR: cases: the 13 clock/acq objects gain finite_clause_limits (supporting probe, the specific unrealized clauses, the obligation actually exercised). No expectation change. Central v13_rows credit removal and repin go to Main.
changes.ST-O-F1 FATAL: oracle: evaluate() receives the selected spec (already SHA-bound) plus the header schemas. Every discriminator, delta, boundary and expected value comes from spec fixed_inputs/expected; model inputs must equal spec. Each branch declares its expected-key set; an unknown key raises Invalid (HOLD). Prose values go through exact tables. Caps join to the verify_source-checked model caps. Budget non-target predicates must hold with positive slack. Parser stimulus is decoded from spec. Expected driver exit comes from spec/added_case_common.
changes.ST-O-F10 MAJOR: step ranges validated (int, bounds, order, non-overlap) and op indices strictly increasing. Driver step() records the model call counter in before/after and refuses steps whose trace is not retained. The oracle proves each slice equals that step's call window, so empty slices are evidence only when valid.
changes.ST-O-F11 MAJOR: writes: strict int, 0<=returned<=requested, requested==remaining length, per-write sha==sha of the reconstructed prefix slice, pipe write fd only.
changes.ST-O-F12 MAJOR: unproved ledgers: exact key set, refs/identities/mono intervals reconstructed, bidirectional uid correspondence with unproved-marked events. Identity ledgers: exact key set.
changes.ST-O-F13 MAJOR: driver outcome-written record kind v2 carries the original-created outcome inode (fstat of the O_EXCL fd); the oracle compares it with the reopen. Parent replacement detection stays J18.

changes.ST-O-F15 MINOR: strict int capture/owner pid/pgid/waitpid_pid/native_wait_status/actual_exit; finite number clocks; same() for structured facts.
changes.ST-O-F2 FATAL: runtime: trip and late decisions use the single recorded main wait mono_after. changes.ST-O-F3 FATAL: eq arms use exact equality (age upper, GO age/remaining, ACK age, cutoff observations); lt/gt arms must be strictly on their declared side. Recomputation uses expressions in source order. The side comes from spec.
changes.ST-O-F4 FATAL: succeeded/raised helpers. Success requires a null exception. Failure requires the exact structure, type GuardError (ValueError only for code ValueError), exact code, repr prefix and null return. code() is retired.
changes.ST-O-F5 MAJOR: count-cap overflow: per-family kind and exact witness joined to step args/state; completed_identity_observation for identity/unproved/variants; exactly one failure row; counts_before/after (no append on refusal, +1 on accept); exact failure codes; count-isolation disclosures kept.
changes.ST-O-F6 FATAL: OUTPUT: spec disposition table. Ack path: acknowledged, exit 10, settlement NOT_LAUNCHED; ack_resources equals the last returned accounting event and the summary; publication_resources equals the prior returned event; receipt/settlement JSON content joined. Refusal path: exit 12 PUBLICATION_REFUSED, ack_resources null, payload/resources joined.
changes.ST-O-F7 MAJOR: helper cutoff, all arms: the recorded rule observation is compared with the deadline. lt/eq: settled, identity valid, reaped rc0, not lost, group/descendant/coverage clear, eof_proved, stdout_closed, return==date==capture text, terminal wait joined. gt: HELPER_CALL_FAILED with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED detail and helper_log retained after the successful reap, date null, clock_failed.
changes.ST-O-F8 FATAL: generic: every terminal waitpid decoded and joined to the main_wait/helper record and s.rc. Every killpg is matched one-to-one to a sent witness, with recomputed fingerprint vs the original identity, target group equality, the preceding fresh 17/13/17/13/17 acquisition ops and chronology. identity_ok is recomputed for every witness.
changes.ST-O-F9 FATAL: grace: cutoffs recomputed from retained stop/exit + settle_s, with exact clearance-rule observation vs cutoff on every arm. gt: no clear, the exact cut failure row (detail+mono) and loop_status. lt/eq: clear timestamp == observation.
changes.ST-P-F1 FATAL: driver main(): authority() keeps its original early lease check and returns that binding epoch. A fresh native epoch is taken after all source/spec binding, immediately before dispatch. Require native_epoch_begin<=binding<=validation<=not_after<=validation+300; otherwise raise Invalid with no dispatch. One final epoch is taken after the authority re-snapshot; require validation<=final<=not_after, else status HOLD. The outcome raw_epoch_end is that exact value and authority_validation_epoch is the pre-dispatch epoch.
